title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Dana Park
description: Adds a set of RAG templates and agent/tool-calling quickstarts to the docs site and examples repo. Motivation: provide opinionated, runnable examples for RAG + agent workflows (retrieval setup, tool wiring, structured outputs) to reduce onboarding friction for customers. This PR includes: 1) three new quickstart guides (RAG-basic, RAG-advanced with streaming, Agent-tool-calling walkthrough) with code snippets and prompts; 2) a set of ready-to-run example projects under redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates (Python + TypeScript) with README and local dev instructions; 3) docs site sidebar and mkdocs config updates to surface the new quickstarts; 4) CI docs checks and a new mkdocs build test in CI to validate examples compile; 5) a small runtime compatibility note for model variants when using tool calling. Checklist: - [x] Quickstarts written and reviewed - [x] Example repos added and smoke-tested - [x] Doc site nav updated - [x] CI docs tests added and green - [x] Release notes skeleton added
